raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pikepdf
  version: "10.18.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b32ee8b0ffe606059dbf3386ebe1dae6e2601098277e22e8c75c2ee982436b43

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      CMAKE_GENERATOR: Ninja
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=
          - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=
          - set "INCLUDE=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include;%INCLUDE%"
          - set "LIB=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib;%LIB%"
      - if: unix and build_platform != target_platform
        then:
          # CMake >=4.4.5 FindPython can't locate free-threaded (cp314t) headers when
          # cross-compiling with CMP0190=OLD; let it query the crossenv interpreter instead.
          # https://github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge.github.io/issues/2901
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation -Ccmake.define.CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0190=NEW -Ccmake.define.CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR=/usr/bin/env
        else:
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - nanobind >=2.5.0
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - nanobind >=2.5.0
    - qpdf >=12.4.2
  run:
    - python
    - pillow >=10.0.1
    - lxml >=4.8
    - packaging
    # pdfa extra
    - jsonschema >=4.18
    - referencing
    - fonttools >=4.40

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pikepdf
        - pikepdf.pdfa
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from pikepdf.pdfa import _deps; _deps.require()"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python

about:
  license: MPL-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: A Python library for reading and writing PDF, powered by qpdf
  homepage: https://github.com/pikepdf/pikepdf
  repository: https://github.com/pikepdf/pikepdf
  documentation: https://pikepdf.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
    - carlodri
